name: EC62 Phuket (Edge Centres)
notes: DCD reported (2022-08-24) Edge Centres deploying EC61 Chiang Mai / EC62 Phuket / EC63 Khon Kaen edge facilities, each with just under 1MW of solar infrastructure, 48-hour battery/UPS and 64 x 1kW quarter-rack capacity; Baxtel lists EC62 Phuket as operational (built 2023, Montri Rd). IT/power capacity not officially disclosed so capacity_mw kept null; grade B (trade press + aggregate directory), per TH methodology treat edge/modular facility as operational lead pending operator official page.

name: Phuket Data Center (KeFF Networks)
notes: Third-party hosting/network posts describe rackspace rented in a Phuket Data Center facility operated by KeFF Networks with upstream/hosting services; no official facility page, capacity, or address found. Aggregate/third-party only, grade C; listed for completeness of Phuket edge/colo market.

name: Phuket AI data centre business permits (aggregate)

name: NT Data Center Hat Yai
notes: Official NT Data Center page for Hat Yai (Songkhla) confirms the site with Tier 3 design and ~40 racks; page states the area is under renovation with estimated completion June 2026, so status recorded as construction (renovation/upgrade). No MW capacity disclosed; NT's national footprint is 9 DCs across 8 provinces per official locations page.
